name: M1 -> G1a/G5: the protect-tier anti-rotation draw loses its gear gate again, so the band-only Pallof press returns to bodyweight and minimal
M2 -> G1c: the day's carry strip is dropped while the gear gate stays, so a protect-tier shoulder is handed a loaded carry
M3 -> G1b: the gear gate is asked about a hardcoded tier instead of the athlete's, deleting the Pallof press from the four tiers that own a band
M4 -> G2a/G4c: the anti-extension pair no longer claims its names, so the anti-rotation re-draw has nothing to avoid and 'Bird dogs' prints twice on one card again
M5 -> G4c: the collision is resolved the wrong way round, the anti-extension section yields and the anti-rotation section keeps the shared movement
M6 -> G4a: the anti-rotation walk starts one step off, so the section prints a pair the rotation never ordered
M7 -> G3d: the re-draw stops after ONE member, so every protect-tier card prints a one-item trunk block instead of a pair
